summary: Implemented the 630 Lambda transform in the MONAI repo. Added `Lambda(func)` in monai/transforms/utility/array.py (raises TypeError if func is not callable) and `Lambdad(keys, func)` in monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py, which accepts one callable for all keys or a per-key list (ValueError on length mismatch), returns a new dict, and has aliases LambdaD/LambdaDict. Added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst and tests in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions; the changes were verified by reading only. No CHANGELOG entry was added.
